channel.title: AI Builder's Field Guide — Recently Added
channel.description: A daily-curated wiki of the tools, models, and patterns that AI power-users and builders actually reach for.

item.title: Sim
item.description: Sim is an open-source workspace designed for building, deploying, and orchestrating AI agents and their associated workflows. — It provides a centralized environment for agent development and management, streamlining the process compared to assembling disparate tools.

item.title: Hallmark
item.description: Hallmark is an open-source design skill for AI coding assistants that aims to eliminate generic AI-generated UI outputs. — It provides a targeted solution for improving the aesthetic quality of AI-generated designs, addressing a common limitation of current AI design tools.

item.title: ChatGPT Work
item.description: An agent in ChatGPT that automates tasks across applications and files, enabling the creation of documents, spreadsheets, presentations, and websites. — It expands ChatGPT's capabilities beyond conversational AI to direct task execution and content generation across various workplace applications, offering a direct competitor to other AI-driven app builders.

item.title: Astryx (Meta)
item.description: Meta's open-source agent-ready design system provides reusable components and guidelines for building consistent user interfaces. — It offers a structured approach for AI agents to generate UIs that adhere to a consistent design language, addressing the challenge of generic AI-built interfaces.

item.title: Colibri
item.description: Colibri is a pure C, zero-dependency engine designed to run large open-weight models like GLM-5.2 (744B MoE) on consumer machines with limited RAM. — It enables efficient local execution of very large open-weight models on standard hardware, significantly lowering the barrier to entry for developers to experiment with powerful models without cloud infrastructure.

item.title: Context.dev
item.description: Context.dev provides an API to extract structured data from any website, enabling agents and applications to programmatically access web content. — It offers a standardized way for AI agents to gather and process information from the web, crucial for tasks requiring up-to-date or specific data that traditional search engines may not structure effectively.

item.title: Strix
item.description: Strix is an AI pentesting tool designed to autonomously identify and exploit vulnerabilities in running applications. — It provides an automated approach to security evaluation, offering a proactive way to test application resilience against AI-driven attacks, complementing traditional security tools.

item.title: Agency-agents
item.description: Agency-agents is a framework for orchestrating a large number of AI agents to collaboratively solve complex tasks. — It explores the paradigm of multi-agent systems, enabling the creation of complex AI workflows where individual agents contribute to a larger objective, a key direction in AI development.
